name: EYWA: Supabase → Notion sync (entity_graph) [v3.32 multi-workspace + DR-038]

parameters.query:
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Phase 1 SELECT: pending rows + brand routing
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- One row → ZERO, ONE, or MANY target workspaces:
--   • brand_scope=['vth-biodent']             → 1 workspace (vt_intelligence)
--   • brand_scope=['classy-clinic']           → 1 workspace (the_gifted_synapse)
--   • brand_scope=['vth-biodent','classy-clinic'] → 2 workspaces (fan out)
--   • brand_scope=['*']                       → universal (operator role, ALL workspaces)
--   • brand_scope=[] OR all brands have NULL notion_workspace → SKIP (logged)
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
WITH brand_routing AS (
  SELECT
    eg.id AS eg_id,
    -- Map: { brand_slug: notion_workspace } from all brands in this entity's brand_scope
    jsonb_object_agg(b.brand_slug, b.notion_workspace)
      FILTER (WHERE b.notion_workspace IS NOT NULL) AS brand_routing_map,
    -- Map: { brand_slug: cloudflare_account_email } — used by image-upload sibling flow
    jsonb_object_agg(b.brand_slug, b.cloudflare_account_email)
      FILTER (WHERE b.cloudflare_account_email IS NOT NULL) AS cf_routing_map
  FROM seo_entity_graph eg
  LEFT JOIN brands b
    ON b.brand_slug = ANY(eg.brand_scope)
  WHERE eg.notion_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY eg.id
)
SELECT
  eg.id,
  eg.fingerprint,
  eg.fingerprint_display_name,
  eg.entity_name,
  eg.entity_slug,
  eg.entity_type,
  eg.entity_subtype,
  eg.topic_cluster_id,
  eg.topic_cluster_name,
  eg.schema_org_type,
  eg.brand_scope,
  eg.entity_lifecycle,
  eg.programmatic_eligible,
  eg.wikidata_id,
  eg.icd_10_code,
  eg.center_scope,
  eg.search_volume_total,
  eg.entity_authority_score,
  eg.aliases,
  eg.ai_entity_summary,
  eg.competing_entities,
  eg.content_gap_flag,
  eg.hreflang_group,
  br.brand_routing_map,
  br.cf_routing_map
FROM seo_entity_graph eg
LEFT JOIN brand_routing br ON br.eg_id = eg.id
WHERE eg.notion_id IS NULL
LIMIT 50;

parameters.query:
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Phase 1 UPDATE — single notion_id column shared across workspaces
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- NOTE: Current seo_entity_graph has only ONE notion_id column.
-- For multi-workspace, last-write-wins on this column. If/when we need
-- per-workspace notion_id tracking, add seo_entity_notion_mirrors table
-- (entity_fp, workspace, notion_id, synced_at) and switch this UPDATE
-- to an UPSERT on that table.
--
-- sync_state:
--   'notion_synced'         = Phase 1 done, Phase 2 backfill pending (vt — has relations)
--   'relations_backfilled'  = no Phase 2 needed (the_gifted — text-FP only)
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
UPDATE seo_entity_graph
SET
  notion_id = $1,
  notion_synced_at = NOW(),
  sync_state = $2
WHERE fingerprint = $3
RETURNING fingerprint, notion_id, sync_state, notion_synced_at;

-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- Error log → seo_data_quality_metrics
-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
INSERT INTO seo_data_quality_metrics
  (metric_name, metric_category, metric_value_jsonb, status, target_table_name, scope_description, computed_at)
VALUES
  ('notion_sync_error', 'sync_lag',
   $1::jsonb,
   'red',
   'seo_entity_graph',
   $2,
   NOW())
RETURNING id;
